## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.5

- Fixes threading from a non-bulleted/numbered list head for ordered lists by using the rendered numeral as the editor path anchor.
- Prevents the occasional far-right overdraw in long, scrolled lists by stopping inferred off-screen ancestor spines at the visible outdent where each subtree ends.
- Replaces the unreliable global-override themed color picker with independent, persistable light- and dark-mode Style Settings controls.
- Uses **All Branches of an Active List Threading** for clearer ordered/unordered-list coverage.
- Retains separate-list isolation, viewport-only rendering, searchable settings, synchronized precise Style Settings number fields, pop-out support, and attested `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` release assets.
